title: Create an uncertainty and sampling record
mission: Create an uncertainty and sampling record using the lesson interactions and accepted prior evidence.

starting_state.known_good_state: The lesson interactions load and the prior contract is available.

guided.objective: Complete the supported activity path and record observable evidence.
steps: Name population, sample, and base rate
Choose an interval and calibration check
guided.expected_observation: The record distinguishes population uncertainty from sample evidence.

challenge.objective: Stress-test a biased sample and explain the misleading conclusion.
steps: Predict the result before changing the scenario
challenge.expected_observation: The bias produces confident but invalid evidence.

engineer_extension.objective: Design slice monitoring and delayed-label recovery.
engineer_extension.expected_observation: Operational slices expose drift hidden by an aggregate.

artifact.name: Create an uncertainty and sampling record

acceptance_criteria: The record distinguishes population uncertainty from sample evidence.
The bias produces confident but invalid evidence.
The artifact identifies its downstream consumer and recovery behavior.
recovery: Return to the lesson's known-good scenario before comparing another change.
